(d) Are there separate hours designated for children/learners? (e) Is adequate lighting maintained during night hours? (f) Are signboards placed at: slippery areas/tiles around pool, no diving in shallow parts, depth of pool marked at various points?

Does the premises have other recreational or public-access facilities such as a Gym, Indoor Games area, Conference Hall, or similar? If yes, please list the type of facilities you have and wish to insure.
For warehouse/godown/depot/tank farm locations: Are these premises occupied solely by you, shared with other parties, or hired/leased to other parties?

Does the premises prepare and/or serve food and beverages to customers/visitors? If yes, answer: (a) Is food preparation done by you or is it outsourced? (Self/Outsourced), (b) Do you have proper quality control measures in place? (Yes/No), (c) What is the annual turnover from food and beverages activity? (INR)

Are you, or any of the proposed applicants, a Politically Exposed Person (PEP)? PEP defined as: individuals who are or have been entrusted with prominent public functions — Heads/Ministers of central or state government, senior politicians, senior government/judicial/military officials, senior executives of government companies, important party officials.
Is the Act of God Perils Extension required? (Condition: building codes must be followed — only available for Superior or Class A construction per PL-PRE-005)
Is the Accidental Pollution Cover extension required? (Annexure C required. Mandated if PL-OPS-007 = Yes — hazardous substances are handled.)
Is the Transportation Liability Extension required for transportation of material and/or hazardous substances? (Annexure B required)

Is the Lift/Escalator/Elevator Liability Extension required? (Triggered if PL-AST-001 = Yes — lifts/escalators present on premises. Without this extension, lift-related accidents are excluded from standard PLI cover.)

Is the Other Facilities Extension required (Gym, Indoor Games, Conference Hall, or similar)? (Triggered if PL-AST-007 = Yes. Without this extension, claims arising from these facilities may be repudiated as undisclosed occupancy.)
Is the Swimming Pool Liability Extension required? (Triggered if PL-AST-006 = Yes — swimming pool present on premises.)
Is the Food & Beverages Liability Extension required? (Triggered if PL-OPS-014 = Yes — food and beverages are prepared or served on premises.)
Is the Carriage of Treated Effluents through Pipeline Extension required? If yes, specify the pipeline distance.
Is the Technical Collaborator Inclusion Clause required? If yes, provide brief details on technical know-how and the collaboration arrangement.

Are books of accounts audited by an independent Chartered Accountant? Are audits complete and unqualified? Do audits cover all locations and entities? Is there an auditor's letter to management on internal control weaknesses, and has management prepared a reply?
Are internal audits performed in addition to, or in place of, external audits? If so, how often? (Please attach a copy of the most recent internal audit report)
Is a complete physical inventory made regularly, including a physical check of stock and equipment? If so, how often?

Separation of duties — Do the employees who reconcile monthly bank statements also (i) sign cheques, (ii) handle deposits, or (iii) have access to cheque signing machines or signature plates? Do employees who prepare cheque requisitions also have cheque-signing authority? Is countersignature of cheques required, and if so, over what limit?
Does the business routinely check the prior employment records and police records of all new employees?

For Class I employees (directors, officers, and employees with access to money, securities, stock, equipment, or other property): What is the total number of all domestic employees? How many are Class I employees specifically? Are employee benefit plans to be included in the policy?
What precautions have been adopted to prevent recurrence of any prior burglary or theft incident?
Do you require cover against Riot, Strike, and Malicious Damage (RSMD)? (Additional premium payable)
Do you require cover against Theft (as distinct from Burglary requiring forcible entry)? This covers shoplifting, pilferage, and theft without evidence of forced entry. (Additional premium payable)
Do you require cover against Terrorist Activities? (Additional premium payable via GIC Re India Terrorism Pool endorsement)
